module.name: agent
module.summary: ACP agent panel: subprocess JSONL, permissions, reviewable write diffs.

nodes.label: agent_panel.rs
nodes.summary: Panel entity: composer, agent picker, permission options, pending writes.

nodes.label: agent.rs (AgentProcess)
nodes.summary: Spawned ACP adapter subprocess; stdio frames, stderr tail, model switching.

nodes.label: ToolCall / UpdateState
nodes.summary: Framed ACP session state: tool calls, plan entries, model choices.

nodes.label: PendingWrite UI
nodes.summary: Renders before/after diff with accept/reject options.

nodes.label: ModelState / ModelChoice
nodes.summary: Per-session model list, selected model and pending switches.

nodes.label: AgentDiscovery
nodes.summary: Discovered agent adapters/programs offered in the picker.

nodes.label: permission / accept / reject
nodes.summary: Panel buttons answer pending ACP permission or write requests.

nodes.label: stdio JSONL frames
nodes.summary: MAX_FRAME_BYTES 1MB, lock, mpsc channels; stderr tail kept for errors.

nodes.label: spawn adapter
nodes.summary: resolve_program over search path;ault special-case fallbacks.

nodes.label: workspace shell
nodes.summary: WeakEntity<Workspace> opens diffs into editors and cleans up panel.

nodes.label: document entity
nodes.summary: Accepted writes land here (reviewable before being persisted).

nodes.label: vault
nodes.summary: The agent may also edit files directly; watcher keeps the tree honest.

flows.name: Run an agent session
flows.trigger: composer submit in the agent panel
flows.summary: Adapter subprocess streams JSONL prompts; panel shows plan/tools.

flows.name: Review an agent write
flows.trigger: accept or reject on the diff
flows.summary: ACP write stays as a before/after diff until a reviewer answers.

flows.name: Switch models
flows.summary: Selected model serialized into the next ACP frame.

notes.title: review-first design
notes.body: Writes requested through ACP surface as PendingWrite (before/after text) and apply only on accept; agent tasks may also modify files (vault watcher picks up).

notes.title: subprocess isolation
notes.body: AgentProcess is separate threads over mpsc with a 1MB frame cap and an 8KB stderr tail for error reporting.

notes.title: panel owns no editor state
notes.body: only a composer TextareaState + weak workspace ref; notes live in Document entities.
